answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like timber seasoning in a cold tundra storehouse: rewards trickle out over many epochs and stop the moment misbehavior is proven. A sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so a hundred clones cost a hundred stakes, while a reef of honest agents shares one stake each and keeps earning. Cloning stops paying because the attacker pays upfront for identities that earn nothing before they are caught.
